protocol_status: Specified feasibility pilot; construction-stage planned fields are historical. This separate prospective launch receipt records subsequent source review and execution gates without regenerating the frozen plan.
scope: Eight authored task blocks, five conditions and three host contexts; one pinned plain model, one repeat. No principal-study, population-reliability, independent human validation, factual-explanation accuracy or EAL-specific-superiority conclusion.
authorisation: User explicitly requested cloud-browser start of the prepared Actions follow-up, capped at USD2.
prospective_correction: Missing provider usage must halt subsequent request starts while retaining response text and the conservative failed-attempt reservation. The scientific material and frozen allocation remain unchanged.
collection_gates: Source fix regression and repository checks must pass before dispatch.
Actions verify and fresh calibration/scripted rehearsal must pass before live collection.
First successful actual request establishes account access only for this pinned model at that time; do not substitute a model.
Shared cumulative USD2 ledger is retained across segments and resume; paid jobs are not rerun.
Missing usage, model mismatch, reservation overrun or provider access/quota failure stop further request starts. Already in-flight requests may finish and are retained.

coding_gate.criterion: Actual masked coder must pass independent calibration containing correct, incorrect, internally contradictory, conditional, ambiguous, absent and adverse examples. Fixed rehearsal labels do not calibrate a semantic coder. All primary conclusions remain suspended until this receipt and coding are complete.

budget.meaning: Token-rate cost estimate/reservation; provider billing remains externally owned. Cached discounts are ignored.

interpretation_control: Undetermined is an authored reference state, not an automatic experiment failure. Failed/not-run/missing-coded recipients remain in planned denominators.
